title: Magnetorotational instabilities in solids: Application to neutron-star crusts
summary: The magnetorotational instability can generate strong, turbulent substructure within magnetized shear flows. The efficacy of the mechanism as a function of microphysical aspects of the fluid, such as stratification and diffusivity, has been explored extensively. One aspect that has not been studied thus far, however, is whether the instability can also operate in solids.
